description.zh: 质量使光偏折 α = 4GM/(c²b)；点质量透镜方程 β = θ − 1/θ 给出两个像，光源在连线上时成爱因斯坦环；θE 随质量平方根增大，恒星是毫角秒（微引力透镜），星系是角秒（弧与环）；可由环的大小称出透镜质量。点质量、弱场、薄透镜模型。
description.en: Mass deflects light by α = 4GM/(c²b); the point-mass lens equation β = θ − 1/θ gives two images, and a source on the axis forms an Einstein ring; θE grows with the square root of the mass, milliarcseconds for stars (microlensing) and arcseconds for galaxies (arcs and rings); the ring size weighs the lens. A point-mass, weak-field, thin-lens model.

label.en: The light path bent by a “medium”

reason.zh: 引力场相当于折射率随位置变化的介质，光线向质量偏折，与光在界面上折射的几何很像，只是原因是时空弯曲。
reason.en: A gravitational field acts like a medium whose refractive index varies with position, bending rays toward the mass, geometrically similar to refraction at an interface but caused by curved spacetime.

label.en: The gravitational potential sets the deflection

reason.zh: 偏折角正比于质量除以最近距离，也就是光线经过处的引力势大小，与引力势能随 1/r 变化的规律一致。
reason.en: The deflection angle is proportional to mass over closest distance, that is, to the gravitational potential where the ray passes, consistent with the 1/r dependence of gravitational potential energy.

title.zh: 为什么遥远的星系会变成一个光环？
title.en: Why does a distant galaxy turn into a ring of light?
